scope: Retrospective descriptive first-observation decomposition on fully banked July outcomes; no historical policy replay or new efficacy gate
targets: all saved target entries with their original multiplicity, fixed uniform integer domain 0..100 including queried integer
weighting: equal target entries per root, equal saved roots per tree, equal all32trees; no root or target selection
shared_pool: canonical extension union of initial and generated first branches from every saved root and both imagined answers; built before examining any target labels
empty_support: report count and predetermined 0.5 predictor for all101targets, never drop a target/root or silently reset support
checks: every extension hash/count, exact tree/root/branch coverage, history consistency, first retained branch equals initial-consistent plus generated, all arms complete
claim_limits: Shared support uses more proposals than the initial arm; not compute matched or a deployed policy. No answer-sham control: opposite-answer banks were explicitly consistency filtered, making that sham tautological. Does not rescue any closed gate.
